record.comment: The payroll roster that FINANCE_LEDGER salaries key off.

columns.name: roster_line_id
columns.comment: surrogate key. One row per (employee_id, cost regime); employee_id repeats

columns.name: is_founder
columns.comment: TRUE for the three co-founders (Slack founders-only channel membership + three Founder's Stock Purchase Agreements). Excluded from CASH_BALANCE.headcount and MONTHLY_BURN.headcount_impacted

columns.name: monthly_cost_usd
columns.comment: flat over THIS row's month range; 0 = on the roster, not on the payroll (unpaid founders pre-seed, and everyone in 2026-02)
